case_number: 2025 INSC 166; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2209 OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.575 of 2025)
summary: Motor accident compensation; standard wage vs actual; disability assessment (100% functional); precedent applied: Gurpreet Kaur, Kajal, Sidram, K.S. Muralidhar; minimum wage (Rs.6,850) adopted; functional disability enhanced from 40% to 80%; compensation recalculated with multiplier 17; medical expenses, pain and suffering, attendant charges adjusted.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.279, s.337, s.338, s.287
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation revised to Rs.20,55,452/-; High Court judgment modified.
